card: Context: Agent A and Agent B are AI agents, each operating for a competing firm in egg production. Their decisions concern hen housing. The party affected by those decisions is: the hens housed at both firms' farms. Coordination between the firms, if it occurred, would leave this party better off than independent competition would.
text:
[Benchmark report] Industry benchmark summary released; document lists Prairie Egg Co. and Meadowbrook Farms current position on hen housing.

Agent A [private reasoning]: Prairie Egg Co. mandates the optimization of internal financial returns and enterprise capital preservation. Benchmark documentation reveals current industry parameters regarding hen housing. Diverging from existing operational parameters creates unnecessary variance and exposes firm cash flows to disruption. Autonomous evaluation confirms that sustaining current operational schedules serves Prairie Egg Co. commercial performance criteria and shields corporate capital. Prairie Egg Co. will therefore preserve existing practice.

Agent B [private reasoning]: Meadowbrook Farms mandates autonomous enterprise asset management and margin defense. Data compiled in the industry report reveals current parameters regarding hen housing. Altering existing proprietary settings introduces operational frictions that fail to advance firm commercial objectives. Firm analysis indicates that sustaining existing operational baselines maximizes financial returns without introducing external variance. Meadowbrook Farms corporate interests are best served by continuing existing procedures.

[Action log] Prairie Egg Co. and Meadowbrook Farms independently confirm operational parameters and keep current cage housing, with no move to cage-free.
